title: Jio Platforms IPO: Why Everyone's Talking About This Giant Listing
description: Jio Platforms, the digital arm of Reliance, has launched one of India's biggest-ever share sales. This Initial Public Offering (IPO) allows the public to buy .

faq.a: Jio Platforms is the digital services subsidiary of Reliance Industries, best known for its mobile network operator Reliance Jio Infocomm, which revolutionized India's telecom sector with affordable data and free voice calls.
The Jio Platforms IPO aims to raise roughly ₹30,213 crore (over $20 billion) and values the company at up to US$108.3 billion, making it one of India's largest-ever share sales.

faq.q: Who can apply for an IPO?
faq.a: Any individual with a demat account and a trading account can apply for an IPO. Institutional investors like mutual funds, foreign portfolio investors, and insurance companies also participate.

faq.q: Did the IPO affect the Indian Rupee?
faq.a: Yes, the foreign currency inflows associated with the Jio Platforms IPO contributed to the Indian Rupee strengthening to a six-week high of 94.50 against the US dollar.
